recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Handle future absence/refutation work through the later clinicalStatus/verificationStatus issue family; treat any removal of unreferenced historical certainty files as a deliberate terminology/source-hygiene task, not a required FHIR-3976 correction.
issue_request: FHIR-3976 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Patient Care issue about overlapping ways to say a Condition did not exist. The approved motion renamed Condition.status to clinical status and removed certainty.
initial_application: Git commit 1f32e2833bae9fb8cc45636c39142020e353b5c6, with git-svn build@4789 matching the Jira comment, renamed Condition.status to Condition.clinicalStatus in the then-current Condition spreadsheet source, updated the status search parameter, and marked Condition.certainty as removed.
additional_context: FHIR-5708 and FHIR-5734 are the same early Condition status/certainty issue family and point back to #3976; FHIR-5708 is already represented on the combined branch. Later Published issues FHIR-7581, FHIR-7864, FHIR-7617, and FHIR-28458 split and refined the current clinicalStatus/verificationStatus/refuted model.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current active Condition StructureDefinition defines clinicalStatus and verificationStatus, current search parameters use clinical-status and verification-status, and searches find no Condition.status or Condition.certainty element/path. Legacy condition-certainty value-set XML files remain unbound and unpublished in the current CI build, so no source edit was necessary for this seed.
